references.text: The parallel passage where Moses receives instructions to make forty silver sockets, with two sockets under each board of the tabernacle.
The immediate context describing the construction of the silver sockets for the boards on the south side of the tabernacle.
The instruction regarding forty silver sockets beneath the twenty boards, with two sockets under each board.
Describes the use of silver to cast the sockets for the sanctuary and the sockets for the curtain.
The responsibility of the Gershonites included oversight of the tabernacle's boards, pillars, and sockets.
The task of the Merarites was to carry the tabernacle's boards, pillars, sockets, and all its accessories.
